STAGE: scope screen of the three frozen proposals against the scope contract (behaviour signal, explicit curved operation, one connected pathway, testable effect with three switches, minimal spec).
READ: rubric-2026-10-v1 and the three evidence bundles (404ea254563870a6 SUCCFAN-CURV-RQ, bc19762831440f87 cocond-markov-poincare-ot, e9e97242e0e9ed08 CURVCELL-SID), items E1-E13 each.
OBSERVED: (a) all three name a training-only behaviour signal with a formula (E1,E2) and an explicit leakage statement (E3); (b) all three name a curved operation with a locus (E12,E13); (c) each has a single pathway, not a side loss: SUCCFAN multiplies the residual chain, cocond puts curvature in the Sinkhorn cost and the barycenter, CURVCELL puts it in the argmin plus the commitment term; (d) each declares USE_BEHAVIOUR / USE_HYPERBOLIC switches and a Stage3 recall@10 > 0.065 criterion.
REASONING: all three pass the five scope clauses; my disagreements are scoring questions (whether the curved computation survives as curvature, and whether the behavioural premise is measured at the operative granularity), not admission questions.
OPEN: the per-proposal scoring, objections and counterexamples, plus a check on the claimed costs and on the sign of the CURVCELL intervention.

STAGE: SUCCFAN-CURV-RQ analysis (block 1).
READ: bundle 404ea254563870a6, E1,E2,E3,E5,E6,E8,E10,E11,E12,E13 (E14 is empty/truncated in the copy I was given).
OBSERVED: E5 gives a measured 5-bin successor-entropy stratification with item counts (bin1 H=0.931 top1=0.4375 over 4895 items, bin5 H=3.405 top1=0.0543 over 44.3 mean support); E10 gives 115,582 distinct directed edges, mean_outgoing_degree 5.4526; E11 gives same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 against a permuted null of 0.067; E6 shows gold-prefix survival collapsing 1.000/0.829/0.161/0.085 at depths 1-4 for the best Euclidean arm.
REASONING: fanout spread is well measured, but nothing measures that high-fanout prefixes actually collide in the current level-2/3 codes, so the behavioural problem is plausible-and-testable (3), not audited (5). The curved object reduces to a per-item scalar gain: level-1 argmin ||lambda_p r - c_j|| equals argmin ||r - c_j/lambda_p||, so the composition is a per-item codebook rescale and a matched Euclidean control reproduces it (geometry 2). The gain has a singularity at c_p||r||^2 = 1 and flips sign beyond it, and the (0.1,10) clip is asserted, not derived.
OPEN: written as block 1 with the full numbers.

STAGE: cocond-markov-poincare-ot analysis (block 2).
READ: bundle bc19762831440f87, E1,E2,E3,E5,E6,E8,E9,E10,E11,E12,E13.
OBSERVED: E10 gives mean_outgoing_degree 5.4526 over the item set; E9 gives the cohort-profile signal 0.9291 vs 0.8871 and 0.5898 of pairs beating all ten negatives; E11 gives 0.0907 vs a 0.067 null; E5 gives the entropy stratification.
REASONING: with 24556 items and B=1024, the expected number of an anchor's successors landing in the same batch is 5.4526 * 1024/24556 = 0.227, so about 1-e^-0.227 = 80% of rows of B_bt are all-zero and the Markov step is near-identity for those rows; this is a measured, not speculative, weakness of the operative signal. The cost claim is arithmetically wrong if the B x B @ B x K product is dense (2*1024^2*256 = 5.4e8 flops per product, 9 products per step = 4.8e9, against a claimed 5-8 MFLOP total), so the "under 5%" figure only holds for the sparse reading, which is the reading the sparsity objection undermines. alpha and q are said to be "measured, never tuned" but their computation is deferred to a SAFEGUARDS text that is not in the spec, which is a policy-relevant gap. Curvature is genuinely in the cost kernel and the mean operator (geometry 3), and the pathway is not a side loss.
OPEN: written as block 2.

STAGE: CURVCELL-SID analysis (block 3).
READ: bundle e9e97242e0e9ed08, E1,E2,E3,E5,E6,E10,E11,E12,E13.
OBSERVED: E5 entropy spread 0.931 to 3.405 nats; E10 115,582 distinct edges, edge_density 5.3266; E11 0.0907 vs 0.067; E12 gives s = sqrt(kappa) = log(1+B)/((d-1)R) with distance divided by s.
REASONING: dividing a distance by a per-code scalar is exactly a weighted-Voronoi / power-diagram nearest-neighbour, which a Euclidean metric reproduces with per-code weights, so geometry scores 2, and the Poincare base distance is the inherited curved quantizer map. The sign of the intervention is incoherent with the motivation: larger B gives larger s, larger s shrinks d/s, so high-branching codes win farther points and claim LARGER cells, which coarsens the region that the motivation says must be separated into eight branches; the stated expected observable (Spearman(|A_k|, B_k) positive) confirms the coarsening direction rather than the finer-resolution story. The refresh weight ((t-1)*s_old + s_new)/t uses the epoch index t, so at t=2048 the new measurement carries weight 1/2048 rather than 1/12, which is a cumulative mean over epochs, not over the 12 refreshes.
OPEN: written as block 3; final answer next.

RECORD 1/4 -- SUCCFAN-CURV-RQ review
GOAL: score the proposal on the seven rubric dimensions and decide the scope verdict from the frozen bundle alone.
READ: the proposal text (behaviour = popularity-adjusted directed successor fanout f_i aggregated to the current SID prefix node p; curvature c_p; conformal factor lambda_p(x)=2/(1-c_p||x||^2) multiplying the level-l residual at encode and dividing at decode) and bundle 404ea254563870a6 (E1-E13).
OBSERVED: (a) E5 measures fanout heterogeneity with coverage (4895 items in the lowest-entropy bin, distinct successors 2.72 -> 41.41, top1 mass 0.438 -> 0.054); (b) E11 measures same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 against a permuted null of 0.067 on the existing baseline SIDs; (c) E6/E7 show the whole successor-in-quantizer family measured BELOW the Euclidean control on the frozen test split (successor_entropy 0.05122, successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500, tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207); (d) E12 declares c_p in (0.1,10.0) with a clamp.
REASONING: the pathway is genuinely one chain (fanout -> c_p -> lambda -> residual amplitude -> assignment), so criterion 3 holds. But lambda_p * x is a per-prefix positive radial rescaling r -> 2r/(1-c_p r^2), which a Euclidean per-prefix bandwidth reproduces, so geometry_necessity = 2. The declared geometry-off limit is arithmetically false: lim_{c->0} 2/(1-c||x||^2) = 2, not 1, and the behaviour-off arm c_p = 1 leaves lambda = 2/(1-||x||^2) != Euclidean, so the control arms differ in more than the intended switch (falsifiability 2). Encode/decode is not an involution when lambda differs per level, so the autoencoder reconstructs a lambda-scaled latent unless the codebooks are rescaled too (implementability 2). The successor-in-quantizer family already carries measured negatives, so novelty 2 and exploration_value 2. Behaviour evidence 3: the heterogeneity statistic is measured, but the specific claim (flat resolution is the bottleneck) is not.
OPEN: whether the intended lambda was normalised by lambda_p(0) (which would make the geometry-off arm well defined) and whether the residual norms ever approach 1/sqrt(c_p) <= 0.316, where the factor has a pole. Both are bounded checks on the Stage-1 latent norms; neither is available in the bundle.
VERDICT: IN_SCOPE. behaviour_evidence=3 geometry_necessity=2 novelty=2 downstream_mechanism=3 falsifiability=2 implementability=2 exploration_value=2

RECORD 2/4 -- cocond-markov-poincare-ot review
GOAL: score the OT assignment proposal and decide the scope verdict from the bundle alone.
READ: the proposal (Poincare ground cost for a 3-sweep entropic Sinkhorn plan, one Markov diffusion step P <- (1-alpha)P + alpha*(B_bt @ P) along popularity-adjusted training transitions, hyperbolic Einstein/Klein barycenter codebook update) and bundle bc19762831440f87 (E1-E13).
OBSERVED: E11 same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067 on the baseline SIDs; E8 first-level capacity ceiling K=16 0.3106 / K=64 0.1547 / K=256 0.0822 with negatives; E10 distinct_edges 115582, mean_outgoing_degree 5.4526, edge_density 5.3266 (coverage note: sampled users only); E5/E6/E7 for stratification and beam survival.
REASONING: this is the only one of the three where behaviour and curvature meet inside a single assignment block, so the coupling is real and the curvature is not a side term: Poincare cost + Poincare mean + diffusion all change the argmax. The behavioural problem is measured on exactly the artefact at issue (assignment-level behaviour-blindness, E11) with coverage caveat, so behaviour 4. The matched Euclidean control (Euclidean Sinkhorn with squared cost and Euclidean weighted mean) is only implicit, so geometry 3, not 4. Novelty 3: OT/Sinkhorn assignment plus barycenter is computational and outside the cited ledger (ranks, fork-angle transport, shells, cones, tangent residuals, per-branch curvature, geodesic prefix loss), but entropic-OT quantisation is standard prior art. Falsifiability 4: three switches, failure criterion, discriminating diagnostic (prefix hit-rate rises while recall stays flat = decorative structure). Implementability 3.
UNKNOWN (not a dimension value): the derivation of alpha and of the usage prior q is deferred to a SAFEGUARDS block that is not in the bundle, and the shape of B_bt (batch-restricted item x item, or an epoch-accumulated full matrix restricted to the batch) is not stated. Bounded checks: read the SAFEGUARDS block; count nonzero in-batch transitions over one epoch of real batches.
HARD OBJECTION with numbers: if B_bt is the batch-restricted item graph, then with mean_outgoing_degree 5.4526 (E10) over 24556 items and a batch of 1024, the chance that a given successor falls inside the same batch is 1024/24556 = 0.0417, so the expected in-batch out-degree is 0.227 and P(no in-batch successor) = exp(-0.227) = 0.80. For 80% of rows the diffusion term is exactly zero and the behaviour switch is idle; the residual column rescaling is behaviour-independent. This is the single biggest risk to the mechanism and it is cheap to measure.
VERDICT: IN_SCOPE. behaviour_evidence=4 geometry_necessity=3 novelty=3 downstream_mechanism=4 falsifiability=4 implementability=3 exploration_value=4

RECORD 3/4 -- CURVCELL-SID review
GOAL: score the co-evolving per-code curvature field and decide the scope verdict from the bundle alone.
READ: the proposal (per-code curvature kappa[l][k] = (log(1+B[l][k])/((d-1)R))^2, B = exp of the entropy of the successor-code-group distribution of the cell, 12 EM refreshes, distance d_B(eps,c)/sqrt(kappa) in the argmin and in the commitment term) and bundle e9e97242e0e9ed08 (E1-E13).
